# PoseGuard AI

> Autonomous 3D skeletal animation motion defect analysis system powered by a 235K parameter tiny neural model and deterministic geometric kinematics.

## Overview
- Project Name: PoseGuard AI
- Release: v1.0.2-beta
- Architecture: Hybrid (1D Conv-Residual-BiGRU + Analytical Kinematic Verifier)
- Model Size: 941 KB (235,221 parameters)
- Target Execution: 100% Offline, Consumer CPU (Single-thread latency 0.74 ms/window)
- Supported Defect Types: Foot Sliding, Ground Penetration, Unnatural Pose Transitions, Contact Inconsistency, Bone Stretch Anomalies
- Input Formats: BioVision Hierarchy (.bvh), NumPy Archives (.npz, .npy)
- Interfaces: Python SDK, CLI (`poseguard`), FastAPI REST Server, Three.js 3D Web Studio

## Performance (Held-out Test Motion Family: Subject 6 Pivot Turn)
- Exact Accuracy: 84.52%
- Macro F1: 0.8462
- Precision: 87.67%
- Recall: 85.00%
- False Positive Rate: 1.92%
- Memory: < 280 MB RAM

## Core Principles
1. Lightweight & CPU-Native: No CUDA GPU requirements.
2. 100% Offline Privacy: Zero cloud analytics or telemetry.
3. Advisory QA: Assists animators with actionable suggestions rather than pretending to replace human creative direction.
